description: The second slice of the swarm cards work. Swarm agents now work from cards: they start a card they were dealt, keep its handoff note current as a heartbeat, and finish it with a result and the steps to validate it, which puts it in Review. Only you move a card to Done, from the owner routes; no agent tool can. Spawning an agent gives it a card (the one you name, or one made from its goal). A card holder's report goes through the same finish path and is tied to the card, so accepting the report accepts the card; when the last child card of a parent is accepted the parent moves to Review with every child's steps merged. The owner routes add Done (which also approves the accepted children), send back with a note (the last holder gets the card again, and the note becomes a fact the project agent keeps), release, move, pause and resume with the cascade down child cards, swap, pin, and the per-project switches. This slice is backend only: the board screen waits for the layout pick.
examples: Send a card in Review back with the note 'use the new session api': the agent that finished it holds it again, gets your note word for word, and the project agent keeps the note as a fact with a learned line in its chat.

Pause a parent card with now: the agent holding it and every agent holding a child card are stopped and told to write their handoff, and the response lists the child cards and agents the pause reached.
how_to: Call POST /api/v1/swarm/cards/{card_id}/done on a card in Review to move it to Done as the owner.
Call POST /api/v1/swarm/cards/{card_id}/send-back with a note to reopen a Review card; the last holder is re-held when still alive, else the card waits in Todo.
Call PUT /api/v1/swarm/cards/rules/{project_id} with auto_done, reorder (suggest or auto), pace or dealing to change a project's switches.

Agents use the swarm_card_* tools: swarm_card_start, swarm_card_handoff, swarm_card_finish (result plus how_to_validate), swarm_card_release, swarm_card_create, swarm_card_reorder and swarm_card_deal.
media_exempt: backend only; the board UI waits for the layout pick
name: swarm cards: card tools and owner routes
summary: swarm agents start, hand off and finish cards through new tools, finishing puts a card in Review and only the owner routes move it to Done; spawn, reports, roll-up, send-back and pause are tied to cards.
where: Backend only for now: the owner routes live under /api/v1/swarm/cards and agents reach the same operations through the swarm_card_* tools. The board screen arrives in a later slice.
